brique._comment: Engine-native Matter family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: structure.create
objective.description: Create one new structure descriptor in the local context.

#root.role: Build a new structure descriptor, write it locally, and register the structure in the runtime catalog.

structure_id._comment: Optional. Name for the new structure within the current context. Auto-generated by the engine when absent.

structure._comment: Optional opaque structure descriptor seed. A brique section and kind marker are ensured when absent.

effects.structure_descriptor: A new local structure JSON file is written.
effects.catalog: The local structure catalog gains a new entry.

transformation_contract.morphing: A caller-supplied structure definition becomes a new committed local structure descriptor with an explicit catalog identity and revision.
invariants: If structure_id is omitted, the capacity generates a fresh local structure identifier.
The structure document remains opaque apart from ensuring a brique section, a structure kind marker, and a committed revision.
Creation is local to the current context and cannot overwrite an existing catalog identity.
success: On success, structure.create returns ok=true, the concrete structure_id, and the committed revision.
Successful creation writes the structure JSON file and registers the new structure in the local runtime catalog.
failure: The capacity refuses creation when the designated or generated structure_id already exists in the runtime catalog.
The capacity fails when the supplied structure cannot be marshaled or committed to disk.
notes: Structure content is treated as opaque by the engine.
Kind normalization targets structure projection, not semantic validation of arbitrary fields.
